results.answer:
The player who scored the most goals in the 2022 World Cup was **Lionel Messi**, with a total of **4 goals**.

This insight is based on a query that aggregated goals scored per player during the tournament, identifying Messi as the top scorer. The corrected SQL used for this was designed to properly count and group goals from the match data associated with the 2022 tournament.

toolCalls.name: run_readonly_sql
toolCalls.input:
{
  "sql": "SELECT p.name AS player_name, COUNT(g.id) AS total_goals 
FROM api.world_cup.goals g 
JOIN api.world_cup.players p ON g.scorer_player_id = p.id 
JOIN api.world_cup.matches m ON g.match_id = m.id 
JOIN api.world_cup.tournaments t ON m.tournament_id = t.id 
WHERE t.year = 2022 
GROUP BY p.name 
ORDER BY total_goals DESC 
LIMIT 1",

}

{
  "sql": "SELECT t.name AS team_name, COUNT(g.id) AS goals_scored 
FROM api.world_cup.matches m 
JOIN api.world_cup.teams t ON m.home_team_id = t.id OR m.away_team_id = t.id 
JOIN api.world_cup.goals g ON g.match_id = m.id 
WHERE m.tournament_id = (SELECT id FROM api.world_cup.tournaments WHERE year = 2022) 
AND m.stage = 'knockout' 
GROUP BY t.name",
